description: Returns the full solution of a Plot Speaks mystery (who did it, why, and the clues that pointed there) and what became of each character. Without gave_up: true it is refused unless an accusation is already recorded for that play; with gave_up: true it answers at once. Records that the play ended in a reveal.

gave_up.description: True when the player has said they give up or want the answer without accusing anyone

name: reveal_solution
title: Full reveal
